title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode5 Who Do You Want To Be?

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Episode: Episode5 — Who Do You Want To Be?
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: Huh? You're that person from earlier...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but another turtle told me about what's been going on with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your dream is to carry people across the river on your back, but you're too scared to swim in the water, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do now...?
I didn't really think about how this conversation would go...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just say what you feel, Nene, and everything should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thing is, I think I know what you're going through right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I also have a dream.
I want to become a world-class musical actress...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... There was a time when I didn't think I could.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: You didn't think you could...? Why?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I ended up ruining our show...
Everyone was so sad and disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After that, I became too scared to stand on stage...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not afraid of standing on stage anymore, but I still feel scared about a lot of things...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thought of performing in places I've never been before alongside people I'll be meeting for the first time is kinda scary to me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I've met some people who are so good that I've worried that I'll never be able to do what they can, even if I try.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But whenever I feel that way, I'm able to muster enough courage to keep moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: Where does that courage come from?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My friends, for one, because of all the support they've given me. But also...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think about my hero... The person who gave me my dream. The person who showed me what I wanted to become.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And then I can keep moving forward, even when I'm scared.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll get closer to achieving your dream if you find the courage to take the next step forward.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, please...
If you still want to make your dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll help. So why don't we make it happen together?

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line:
You're such an amazing person.
If I can be just like you—

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Riding on the back of a turtle was so much fun! I'll be back again soon!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, they and the turtles all seem to be enjoying themselves very much.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: I wish I could be like them...

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: I want to carry everyone across, and have them feel happy like that...!

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: But I'll give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
You can do it.
The edge of the water is just right there.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: I-I'm not afraid. I can do this...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He did it! He is in the water.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: I did it...! Look! I'm in the water!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
He looks stable in the water.
I believe he should have no trouble carrying the other plushies across.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: O-Oh, about that... Can I ask you for a favor?

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: So, I'd like to try carrying someone across. If possible, would you be willing to ride on my back...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay.
Let's go for a ride.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...
We're gliding across the water...!

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah, but it feels really nice...!

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: I never realized just how much fun it is to swim at full speed while carrying someone on my back...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line:
Thanks! Anyway, hang on tight...!
I'll take you wherever you want!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Welcome back, you two.
You both seemed to enjoy yourselves very much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We did. That was my first time riding on a turtle's back, but it was really fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was incredible.
This means you should be able to carry everyone across to the other side now♪

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: Thanks. I wouldn't have been able to work up the courage to do that if it weren't for you...!

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line:
So, I should be fine now...!
I feel like I can carry anyone across.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
You guys wanted to go to the other side, right?

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line:
Why don't I take you all across?
I promise to do a good job!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You will? Thank you...
That'd be incredibly helpful.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, while we're at it, can we ask you for something else?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you also be willing to carry our friends across? There's quite a lot of us, if that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line:
No problem!
It'd be great to carry so many people across!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Then, I shall go let them know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm so happy that our turtle friend's back in the water.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Did I do something worthy of being thanked?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You gave me the push I needed to help him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I did?
I honestly just said what I felt...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm glad to hear that I was able to help you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Seeing everyone smile so much is making me sleepy for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you mind if I used your lap as a pillow, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...? My lap? You plan on sleeping here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Also, I'd like to sleep on our turtle's back as he swims. I have a feeling that I'll have a wonderful dream about swimming in the sea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? She fell asleep while standing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still... I'm really glad that I could help him.)

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: Alright, I'll practice swimming while we wait for your friends to get here!

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie
rows.Line: I'm still a little scared of the water... But I'm gonna keep trying my best...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The future's full of scary and not-so-nice things...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not just the turtle's... Mine as well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just have keep remembering my dream. My hero...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to maintain this courage and keep moving forward.)
